visual_observations: R3 reduces vegetable variety and gives more room to the forest compared with R2. It is a photographic composition change, not demonstrated improvement in intrinsic photo realism.
Several idealized napa cabbage surfaces and neatly presented radishes look unusually uniformly attractive; scattered soil flecks alone do not establish believable harvest and physical wear.

Leaf edges, veins, moisture, gloss and foreground foliage remain highly legible and decorative across the frame; lighting/texture do not convincingly express a single messy real-world forest light and camera capture.

Vegetables from fields (cabbage, daikon and chili) arranged in a damp wild forest basket have a staged setting without a visible credible harvesting or handling context. A composed advertising still-life is permissible, but should not be claimed as spontaneously documentary.

Original forest mushroom poster reference itself mixes curated editorial still-life with natural atmosphere; copying only moss, ferns and an attractive bamboo basket is insufficient to preserve the scene-forming photographic mechanism.
diagnosis.do_not_infer_user_specific_rejected_area: User did not detail anatomical local faults; above are executor's diagnosis only.

historic_progress.earlier_positive_cabbage_still_life: Separate cabbage-on-dark-ground case was user-praised, but different source and environment; do not overgeneralize preference or conflate photo families.

actions: Analyze approved-looking cabbage still life and rejected R1–R3 in the same photographic dimensions: scene causality, material heterogeneity, coherent practical lighting, lens/focus falloff, amount of art-directed display.
Separate 'genuinely believable forest-cultivated harvest photography' versus 'deliberately styled editorial still-life in a forest'; decide which is the creative premise before making a new image.
Extract a compact, falsifiable photographic correction; do not just add generic 'less AI, softer, more imperfect' prompts.
If a new image is later requested, allow only one bounded candidate after the correction hypothesis is settled; do not reroll to chase taste.
